summary: The setup for Thursday has steadied overnight: Wall Street clawed back most of a deep sell-off, Asian chip stocks are rebounding, and both foreign and domestic funds bought Indian shares on Wednesday.

detail.leaders: FMCG and banks, which led Wednesday's rebound
detail.laggards: Metals, led by Tata Steel, which stayed weak on Wednesday
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for the session ahead. Firmer than the previous note: the US sell-off that clouded the outlook last night largely reversed before the close.
